crossRefs.note: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,
As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;
Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and…
Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.
For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.
For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him…
When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn’t come to Corinth to spare you.
For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were…
For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by…
that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before…
For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority…
What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

translations.web: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.
translations.bsb: So I made up my mind not to make another painful visit to you.
translations.kjv: But I determined this with myself, that I would ➔ not come again to you in heaviness.
translations.asv: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come again to you with sorrow.
